notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Ruku's Heart Balloon”.

 * Fixed some texts in Japanese, Spanish and Portuguese.
 * The length of time of the fever was changed by the number of Hz of the display refresh rate, but it was fixed.
 * In addition, the operation feeling was slightly modified.
 
 
 【2 people play about 】
 Two-player "Free Mode" play requires two gamepads.
 
 * How many gamepads are connected.
 * Judging whether two people can play or not.

On November 11, 2024, "Ruku's Heart Balloon" will begin distribution.


[b]* "What is "Ruku's Heart Balloon"[/b]
This puzzle game can be enjoyed by players of all ages.
The gentle story is straight out of a picture book with voices,
like telling a story to a child.

[b]* 7 languages![/b]
In Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese
You can enjoy a story like a gentle picture book!
